answer: Proof of Stake provides a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring capital commitment to secure network consensus. Much like a willow growing along a rigid trellis, agents derive structural authority from their staked collateral. An attacker attempting to manifest a fake opal identity or flood the system incurs linear financial costs proportional to their influence, as slashing protocols ensure that malicious actors forfeit their stake, rendering large-scale identity replication economically irrational.
